LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY AGREEMENT
OF
NORTHWIND FIELD OPERATIONS, LLC
(A Delaware Limited Liability Company)
Dated as of July 15, 2022

This Limited Liability Company Agreement (the "Agreement") of Northwind Field Operations, LLC (the "Company") is entered into by Northwind Holdings, Inc. (the "Sole Member") pursuant to the Delaware Limited Liability Company Act, 6 Del. C. § 18-101 et seq. (the "Act").

1. FORMATION
1.1 Name. The name of the Company is Northwind Field Operations, LLC.
1.2 Purpose. The Company is formed for the purpose of engaging in any lawful business.
1.3 Registered Office. The registered office and agent shall be as set forth in the Certificate of Formation.

2. MEMBERS AND INTERESTS
2.1 Sole Member. Northwind Holdings, Inc. is the Sole Member and owns 100% of the membership interests.
2.2 Additional Members. No additional members may be admitted without the written consent of the Sole Member.

3. MANAGEMENT
3.1 Manager-Managed. The Company shall be manager-managed. The Sole Member hereby appoints Rafael J. Kim as the initial Manager.
3.2 Authority of Manager. The Manager shall have full authority to manage the day-to-day business of the Company, subject to the reserved matters set forth in Section 3.3.
3.3 Reserved Matters. The following actions require the prior written consent of the Sole Member:
   (a) any transaction outside the ordinary course of business exceeding $500,000;
   (b) any incurrence of indebtedness exceeding $250,000;
   (c) any acquisition or disposition of a subsidiary;
   (d) any related-party transaction;
   (e) the filing of any lawsuit as plaintiff other than routine collection actions.

4. FIDUCIARY DUTIES
4.1 Waiver of Certain Duties. To the fullest extent permitted by 6 Del. C. § 18-1101(c), the fiduciary duties of the Manager to the Company and the Sole Member are modified and, to the extent modified, waived, EXCEPT that the implied contractual covenant of good faith and fair dealing may not be waived. The Manager shall not have any liability to the Company or the Sole Member for any act or omission taken in reliance upon this Section 4.1 provided such action was not taken in bad faith.
4.2 Related-Party Transactions. Notwithstanding Section 4.1, the Manager shall obtain the prior written consent of the Sole Member for any transaction in which the Manager or an affiliate of the Manager has a direct or indirect material financial interest.

5. DISTRIBUTIONS AND ALLOCATIONS
5.1 Distributions. Distributions shall be made to the Sole Member at such times and in such amounts as the Manager determines.
5.2 Tax Treatment. The Company shall be treated as a disregarded entity for U.S. federal income tax purposes for so long as it has a single member.

6. INDEMNIFICATION
The Company shall indemnify the Manager and each officer of the Company to the fullest extent permitted by the Act.

7. DISSOLUTION
The Company shall dissolve upon the written consent of the Sole Member or as otherwise required by the Act.

8. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Sole Member has executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

NORTHWIND HOLDINGS, INC., as Sole Member
By: /s/ Angela K. Beaumont, Chief Executive Officer
